overrides: the mission smoke's manual 1/60 s clock
the mission smoke's test placements of the production player body (each one listed in report.json under `placements`)
unknowns: the camera's field of view is unmeasured (no track carries one); the run keeps the window's projection
the camera variant draws come from the original's `rand()` table seeded by the clock; the stream is not reproducible from the data, so the run prints the seed it drew
whether the letterbox bars slide in or out or appear at once, and when they leave, is unmeasured; the implementation switches them at the phase bounds
the cinematic's tick-rate relation is a choice: the original steps a variable game_dt, and the measured length is rounded up to whole 120 Hz ticks
what the original's HUD shows during the cinematic is unmeasured; this build hides the cockpit HUD root and the actor and objective markers while the phase plays
the intro's actor tracks (gi_player1/2, gi_pfighter1/2) are not driven yet: the player's plane does not drop past the Pandora and the actors keep their composed poses during the cinematic
the hand-over pose's residuals stand in launch_body::BODY_UNKNOWNS (node-detach-after-intro, cinematic-flag-clear, airframe-mode, network-gate-value, velocity-integration, no-run)

review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with `retail,gpu,audio` (CS_GAME_DIR, CS_ENGINE_IMAGE): the owner's own command `cs --cs-path $CS_GAME_DIR --mission M01 --smoke-seconds 45 --capture-dir private/evidence/PARITY-M01-LAUNCH-CINEMATIC` drove the windowed composition the owner plays on this machine's GPU through the whole launch — it opened on the Flight Check (`flight_check_screen_drawn`, `flight_check_text_matches`, `flight_check_buttons_drawn`: every text row and button adds pixels in its own region), delivered Fly Mission through the front-end machine itself (`flight_check_fly_mission`), sat out the measured cinematic (`launch_cinematic_plays`: 4818 of 4818 ticks, handed over, 0.000 m drift against a 0.5 m ceiling, 0.040 deg turn against 0.5, letterbox bars on while playing and off after, with the pixel floors measured: the bar rows >=990 per mille black and <=20 HUD-green pixels while held, bars gone and >=200 HUD-green pixels at `cinematic_handover`), played the measured camera script (`launch_cinematic_camera_played`: 2440 frames driven, 4 of 4 scenes on screen, 0 frames without the Pandora entity, 7 scene screenshots) and reached `first_control_frame` at tick 4818 (frame 2410) on (-1426.0, 250.0, -1813.0) m, yaw 40.0 deg, zero scripted moves — 21 checks, 0 failed, 28 framebuffer PNGs and report.json under the evidence directory. The acceptance tests prove the same ordering headlessly on the production seams `run_windowed` drives: the check holds the fixed clock at tick zero with the cinematic armed but unticking, the press's own frame runs zero ticks (the release lands in PreUpdate), and 2409 updates of two fixed ticks hand control back at the composed start pose with the pre-cinematic velocity untouched. The run is automated, never `human_play`, and no original executable ran; nothing is `verified_original`. This harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the smoke's report and the hashes of those artifacts. LIMITS: the camera field of view is unmeasured, the variant draw's rand() stream is unreproducible (the run prints its seed), the bars' slide timing and the HUD's original in-cinematic look are unmeasured, the tick-rate relation is a choice (variable game_dt rounded up to whole 120 Hz ticks), the intro's actor tracks are not driven, and the hand-over pose's residuals stand in launch_body::BODY_UNKNOWNS — all recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-19-parity-m01-launch-cinematic.md. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py (structure and artifact hashes, exit 0); --require-pass reports the recorded unknowns as unresolved issues, which stand as this slice's honest limitations rather than being emptied to pass the gate.
